CONCLUSION: non-conservation (add/reduce memory one-sidedly) does NOT strengthen the lever - the binding constraint is statistical power at n=3, not memory conservation. No frozen surface moved, no verdict promoted. Evidence: verification_outputs/gap40b-lineageflow-bias-modes/{n200_screen,n1000_negative}/. docs/audit/gap40-lineageflow-classifier-aware-restart.md sec 4d. GAP-34 (2026-10-16, RESOLVED via path (a)): the R1 init dose-response experiment (tools/sweep_gap34_init_dose.py; tau = AA-logit temperature of the per-record init simplex softmax(randn*tau); tau in {0,0.25,0.5,1.0,2.0}; 3 seeds 42/43/44; N=1000; --nfe 10; single-pass init-only arm; canonical HMMER counter) shows the per-record random init is a LEGITIMATE, LOAD-BEARING, MODEL-MEDIATED mechanism component: tau=0 (near-uniform) collapses to 0 hits on all 3 seeds, tau=1 (canonical softmax(randn)) gives 298/274/290 (mean 287.3, reproducing the D-004b init-only arm exactly), paired rise t=40.73 p=6.0e-4. The dose-response is NON-MONOTONE / inverted-U: mean hits 0 -> 266.7 -> 269.0 -> 287.3 (peak at tau=1.0) -> 207.7 at tau=2.0; Spearman rho per seed 0.40/0.30/0.90 (mean 0.53). HONEST CAVEAT: the tau=2.0 fall is seed-heterogeneous (seed42 62, seed43 247, seed44 314; sd 130.5 vs 12.2 at tau=1.0) - so the shape is 'interior optimum at the canonical tau=1 with a high-variance high-tau regime', not a clean dome. The canonical tau=1.0 sits at the interior optimum. R1 verdict unchanged (PARTIAL); no frozen surface moved. Evidence: verification_outputs/gap34-r1-init-dose/. docs/audit/gap34-r1-init-dose.md.
